localPress.description: Hendersonville/Asheville area press outlets for PR outreach

outlets.name: Hendersonville Times-News
pitchAngles: Local business spotlight — family furniture store in downtown Hendersonville
Made-in-USA futon frames and sustainable furniture
Small business resilience / e-commerce expansion story
outlets.notes: Primary local daily. Business section runs local merchant profiles regularly.

outlets.name: Mountain Xpress
outlets.coverage: Asheville area arts, culture, progressive news
pitchAngles: Sustainable/eco-friendly furniture angle — organic cotton covers, solid wood frames
Local maker/artisan economy story
Small-space living solutions for Asheville apartment dwellers
outlets.notes: Alt-weekly with strong eco/sustainability readership. Good fit for organic cotton and hardwood frame angle.

outlets.name: Asheville Citizen-Times
outlets.coverage: Buncombe County and WNC regional news
pitchAngles: WNC small business growth story
Furniture industry in Western NC — heritage and innovation
Holiday gift guide / seasonal home furnishing features
outlets.notes: Largest regional daily. Holiday gift guides and seasonal features accept local merchant submissions.

outlets.name: Hendersonville Lightning
pitchAngles: New product launch announcements
Community involvement / sponsorship announcements
Store events and promotions
outlets.notes: Hyper-local community paper. Good for event announcements and community involvement.

outlets.name: Blue Ridge Now / Hendersonville Magazine
outlets.coverage: Blue Ridge lifestyle, dining, shopping, tourism
pitchAngles: Home decor / interior design feature with futons as versatile furniture
Local shopping guide inclusion
Mountain living / cabin furnishing feature
outlets.notes: Lifestyle/tourism publication. Seasonal home features and shopping guides.

outlets.name: WNC Business Journal
outlets.coverage: Western NC business news, commercial real estate, startups
pitchAngles: E-commerce growth story — brick-and-mortar to online
Small business technology adoption
Furniture retail industry trends in WNC
outlets.notes: B2B audience. Good for business milestone announcements and e-commerce expansion stories.

industryPublications.description: Furniture industry trade publications and blogs that accept features/reviews

publications.name: Furniture Today
publications.relevance: Leading furniture industry trade pub. Covers retail, manufacturing, design trends.
pitchAngles: Futon market growth and modern design evolution
Small retailer e-commerce success story
Product launch announcements for new frame/cover designs
publications.submissionType: press releases, product submissions, retailer profiles

publications.name: Home Furnishings Business (HFB)
pitchAngles: Independent retailer spotlight
Customer experience and showroom innovation

publications.name: Casual Living
publications.relevance: Covers casual/lifestyle furniture including futons and convertible pieces.
pitchAngles: Futons as versatile casual furniture for multi-use spaces
Outdoor-to-indoor convertible furniture trends

publications.name: Apartment Therapy
publications.relevance: Major consumer home decor site. Small-space furniture is core content.
pitchAngles: Best futons for small apartments — product roundup submission
Guest room solutions — futon as sofa-bed alternative
Dorm room furnishing guides
publications.submissionType: product submissions for roundups, sponsored content

publications.name: The Spruce
publications.relevance: High-traffic home and garden site. Runs buyer guides and product reviews.
pitchAngles: Best futon frames / covers buyer guide inclusion
How to style a futon — room makeover feature
publications.submissionType: product samples for review, buyer guide submissions

publications.name: Wirecutter (NYT)
publications.relevance: Authoritative buyer guide. Has existing futon mattress/frame guides.
pitchAngles: Submit products for futon frame and futon mattress buyer guides
Provide expert commentary on futon selection criteria
publications.notes: Highly competitive. Best approach is submitting products when they update their futon guides.

publications.name: Sleepopolis
pitchAngles: Futon mattress review — comfort and sleep quality angle

blogAndInfluencer.description: Home decor blogs and influencers open to furniture features

targets.name: Small Space Living blogs
targets.angle: Futons as the ultimate small-space solution

targets.name: College/Dorm decor influencers
targets.angle: Dorm room and first apartment furnishing

targets.name: WNC lifestyle bloggers
targets.angle: Local business support, mountain living aesthetic
targets.approach: Local blogger events, showroom visits, affiliate partnerships

localEvents.description: Regional events where Carolina Futons could participate or exhibit

events.name: WNC Home & Garden Show
events.opportunity: Booth exhibitor — showcase futon frames, live demonstrations of convertible function
events.notes: Major regional home show. Direct consumer audience actively shopping for furniture.

events.name: Hendersonville Art on Main
events.opportunity: Sidewalk display outside store, special event pricing, cross-promote with gallery walk traffic

events.name: NC Apple Festival
events.opportunity: Sponsor or booth — 200K+ annual visitors, massive foot traffic on Main Street
events.notes: Largest annual event in Hendersonville. Primarily tourism/food but local business visibility is high.

events.name: Asheville Home Designers' Showhouse
events.opportunity: Furnish a room in the showhouse with futon/convertible furniture
events.notes: Great for brand positioning with interior designers and upscale consumers.

events.name: High Point Market
events.opportunity: Attend for sourcing, industry networking, trend research. Consider small showroom.
events.notes: World's largest furniture trade show, 2 hours from Hendersonville. Industry-only event.

events.name: Back-to-School / Move-In Season
events.location: UNC Asheville, Brevard College, Blue Ridge Community College campuses
events.opportunity: Flyers, campus bulletin boards, student discount promotions, dorm delivery service
events.notes: Peak futon sales season. Partner with campus housing offices for recommended vendor lists.

events.name: Hendersonville Farmers Market
events.opportunity: Cross-promote with market flyers, sponsor market bags with CF branding
